LOCAL PRICE & YIELD SENSITIVITY

Room for market uncertainty

Local evidence matters. Prices differ by country, market, crop grade, buyer, contract, season and date. AgriPulse never invents a local price: use a current farm-gate, cooperative, contract or wholesale quote.

What these values mean

Weather and near-surface moisture are model values at a reference grid. A polygon describes your chosen boundary; its area does not make the weather data more precise. Rotation paths use general crop characteristics. Profit uses the assumptions you enter.

ABOUT AGRIPULSE

Built by students. Grounded in purpose.

Meet the school and team behind AgriPulse.

OUR SCHOOL

Dunia Alajial International School

AgriPulse was developed at Dunia Alajial International School, where students turn scientific ideas, technology and teamwork into projects designed to help people and communities.

OUR TEAM

The Tech Team

The Tech Team created the AgriPulse experience—from the visual identity and interface to the field planning tools that connect Earth observations with practical farm decisions.
